Good afternoon. Thank you for joining us for our Q1 2023 earnings call.
I'm the Chief Executive Officer of META.
Operating income reached $9.8 billion, demonstrating the operating leverage in our model.
Our outlook assumes current foreign exchange rates hold; currency fluctuations could materially affect results.
I'll now turn the call over to our CFO for a more detailed financial review.
Thank you. Our Chief Financial Officer will now provide the financial details for Q1 2023.
Customer acquisition exceeded our targets with 983 thousand new accounts added in the quarter.
While we remain optimistic, there can be no assurance that macroeconomic headwinds won't affect demand.
We will now begin the question-and-answer session.
Analyst - First question:
How should we think about the cadence of revenue recognition in the second half?
Thank you for the question. Our gross margin expanded by 198 basis points to 64.1%, reflecting improved operational efficiency.
Second question - Analyst:
Could you quantify the FX headwind embedded in your guidance?
We anticipate margins may be impacted by approximately 198 basis points pending supplier contract renewals.
